title: Cookbook:Tom Yum Gai
categories: Recipes using chicken broth and stock
ingredients_raw: 400 grams (about 1 lb) boneless chicken meat, diced
1 fresh lemongrass stem, cut into short lengths
5–6 hot fresh Thai chilies, just broken with pestle
steps: Place the stock in a pot, add the lemongrass and kaffir lime leaves, and bring to boil over medium heat.
Add the chicken meat, mushroom, fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar; cook slowly and uncovered for 10 minutes. Do not stir.
Add the tomatoes and chilies and cook for 5 more minutes. Remove from heat.

{{recipe summary|

==Ingredients==

* 400 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] (about 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]]) boneless [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] meat, [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] chicken [[Cookbook:Stock|stock]]
* 100 grams (3.5 oz) straw [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushrooms]], halved 
* 6 cherry [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* 1 fresh [[Cookbook:Lemongrass|lemongrass]] stem, cut into short lengths
* 2–3 [[Cookbook:Kaffir Lime Leaf|kaffir lime leaves]], torn
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] Thai [[Cookbook:Fish Sauce|fish sauce]]
* 4 tbsp fresh [[Cookbook:Lime|lime]] juice
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 5–6 hot fresh Thai [[Cookbook:Chiles|chilies]], just broken with [[Cookbook:Mortar and Pestle|pestle]] 
==Procedure==
#Place the stock in a pot, add the lemongrass and kaffir lime leaves, and bring to [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over medium heat.
#Add the chicken meat, mushroom, fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar; cook slowly and uncovered for 10 minutes. Do not stir.
#Add the tomatoes and chilies and cook for 5 more minutes. Remove from heat.
#Serve with steamed jasmine rice.
